notes.title: "Shadow Code: Lucy" has been officially announced!
notes.notes:
"Shadow Code: Lucy" is an adult-oriented game that combines adventure and puzzle-solving elements. Despite her glamorous appearance, Lucy, the eccentric thief, is actually quite technologically inept and impoverished. Players will assume the role of an intelligence technology expert and collaborate with Lucy to pull off daring heists, helping her turn her life around and gain fame.

Throughout the missions, players will assist Lucy in tasks such as wiretapping phones, bypassing security systems, and cracking codes. As they face various puzzles together, their bond with Lucy deepens, and they even engage in physical intimacy! Lucy, who appears silly and cute (although she doesn't see it that way), possesses a sensuality and sensitivity that make players eager to engage with her.

Featuring exquisite hand-drawn and animated CG scenes, be sure to follow "Shadow Code: Lucy" and add it to your wishlist, as Lucy awaits for you to conquer her!
